specs.Compatible Phone Models: Compatible with iOS and Android devices.

features: JEWELLERY-STYLE SMART BAND FOR WOMEN: A slim 36 x 9 x 5mm screenless band with a zinc alloy front case and an elegant epoxy-infill finish. It looks like a bracelet, not a gadget, so you can wear it to work, the gym, a wedding or an evening out.

24/7 HEART RATE, SpO2, HRV & STRESS: Monitors heart rate, blood oxygen (SpO2), HRV and stress around the clock. It also gives emotion and fatigue level insights. Everything syncs to the Oplayer Smart Life app to help you understand your daily rhythm.

AUTO SLEEP TRACKING & PAI SCORE: Full-day automatic sleep tracking shows how well you rest. Activity tracking and a PAI (Personal Activity Intelligence) score turn your steps and workouts into one simple daily health goal.

120+ SPORT MODES FOR EVERY ROUTINE: Tracks walking, running, treadmill, cycling, yoga, pilates, skipping, aerobics, badminton, tennis, cricket, gym workouts and more. From a morning yoga flow to an evening walk, every move counts.

IP68 WATER RESISTANT, ALL-DAY COMFORT: The IP68 rating handles sweat, rain and hand washing with ease. A smooth IML glass caseback and lightweight 25g build sit comfortably on the wrist, so you can wear your fitness bracelet day and night.

LONG BATTERY & EASY PAIRING: Fully charges in about 2 hours with the magnetic pogo-pin charger. It lasts up to 6-7 days with normal use and 12 days on standby. Pairs over Bluetooth 5.4 with Android 8.0+ and iOS 12+ through the Oplayer Smart Life app.
